decks.summary: Support Carson who hands out actions and commits four-icon skills like Promise of Power, Desperate Search and Occult Theory made wild through Bestow Resolve, with Runic Axe and Hunter's Armor to hold his own.
Primary-fighter Carson who shoots a Lightning Gun kept loaded by Venturer and Custom Modifications and swings a Runic Axe, while still giving his partner extra actions.
Action-engine Carson who gives teammates extra actions with Police Badges and Leadership, recurs allies with A Chance Encounter, and sits behind Tetsuo Mori and Safeguard.
Self-sacrificing multiplayer Carson built to take every hit: Tetsuo Mori, True Grit, Solemn Vow and "Let me handle this!" pull damage and horror onto him while he hands out actions.
Ironman tank Carson who never tries to pass tests: he gives out three actions a turn, soaks with Hunter's Armor, Safeguard and Something Worth Fighting For, and heals allies with Emergency Aid.
Pure-support Carson for three or four players who avoids tests entirely, handing out actions boosted by Guidance and Leadership, with Girish Kadakia and Safeguard to stay with the team.

Full-support Carson who makes his team better with his actions, keeping only Sledgehammer, Hallowed Mirror, Girish Kadakia and Safeguard in play and using At a Crossroads and Nature of the Beast for value.
Blessed support Carson from a Spanish podcast: Rite of Sanctification, Keep Faith and Favor of the Sun bless the bag, a Runic Axe fights, and Girish and Trusted protect the team.
Bodyguard Carson who follows the clue finder, gives them extra actions and zaps enemies with Lightning Guns kept firing by Venturer, Cleaning Kit and Extra Ammunition.
Sniper Carson with Springfield M1903s, Custom Modifications and Venturer, shooting enemies across the map while supporting his team; the guide is a single line.
